report.name: 6000 weighted random plans preserve bounds and maximum streak
option permutation keeps correct answer and never mutates inputs
three-option and four-option groups stay separate
sampling is without replacement until pool exhaustion
article generation uses its own sentence examples and grounded questions
article plan remains stable when other articles are generated
article syntax is varied across sources
vocabulary recall intervals are 1,3,7,14,30 days then mastery
a wrong recall resets only that target
unsupported grammar is not auto-approved
supported grammar matches targets only
random plans have variable totals rather than a fixed answer quota
explanation labels and composed option IDs follow the correct answer
pool validation and a cycle boundary never duplicate a question within a small draw
different meanings are retained; rescan preserves IDs, review state and all sources
the same saved recall event cannot advance a word twice
legacy writing draft retains its original targets and text
writing history is not trimmed at 500 and save IDs are idempotent
new grammar targets use a matching original sentence when the old example is paraphrased
damaged review storage is not overwritten during a harvest
